resolution.rule: The frozen corpus and ground truth are not edited. Each strict-unexpected divergence is adjudicated against evidence available at freeze time: the preregistered expected_contract_risks list is proven incomplete, not corrected retroactively.

classification_taxonomy.meaning: The risk demonstrably existed at freeze and would have been preregistered had the per-entity list been exhaustive; the data and the contract behave as documented.
The primary source changed after the snapshot freeze; would require a new baseline, not present here.
A preregistered expected fact or source presence was wrong, not merely an incomplete risk list; not present here.
The divergence comes from an ambiguous contract clause rather than an omitted risk; not present here.
A genuinely unanticipated divergence; adjudicated on its own root cause instead of being absorbed into the preregistration.

The mechanism is structural to the snapshot, not entity-specific.

The preregistration states that in all ten selected EBA rows ENT_AUT is a date array; SEMANTICS_GAP was preregistered for the other seven EBA-backed entities (G05-011, G05-016, G05-017, G05-018, G05-019, G05-020, G05-021) and this entity did preregister SOURCE_CONTRACT_GAP for the same row, so the defective shape was known at freeze and only its semantics consequence was omitted.

Same EBA date-array mechanism as divergence 6: the entity preregistered SOURCE_CONTRACT_GAP for this row and the preregistration covers all ten selected EBA rows, but SEMANTICS_GAP was left out of this entity's list while present for the other seven.
